slides.title: Beyond GET – Full CRUD 🛢️
slides.content:
# Sending Data to the Server

`HttpClient` provides methods for all REST verbs:

* `post(url, body, options?)`
* `put(url, body, options?)`
* `patch(url, body, options?)`
* `delete(url, options?)`

The second argument is the request body (for POST/PUT/PATCH), and the optional third (or second for DELETE) is an options object containing `headers`, `params`, etc.
